historical_rationale.currency: UDI Rhodesia operated its own pound in January1970 under sanctions; Rhodesian dollar arrived later in1970. A native neutral domestic fallback avoids falsely claiming access to ordinary British reserve guarantees.
historical_rationale.religion: Period evidence shows substantial Christian and indigenous traditions across Rhodesia's whole population, not only the white settler population.
historical_rationale.factions: Settler landholding interests, armed/security institutions and commercial industry represent the existing unrecognized Rhodesian state. Later Zimbabwean patronage structures are not backdated.
